about: {name} is a D2C brand that sells packaged snacks.
description: {name} case study: storefront and festive campaign creative, with homepage, cart, category pages, social tiles and ads, shown as artwork.
kind: D2C brand, packaged snacks and gifting
brief: {name} sells packaged snacks. We built its storefront and campaign creative: the homepage, cart and category pages, plus social tiles and ads for a festive gifting push.
The storefront, the ads and the social creative share one look, so an ad and the page it points to read as the same brand.

showcases.title: Festive homepage on desktop and mobile
showcases.text: A Diwali homepage hero with three special hampers and one button, and a phone version that leads into shop by category.

showcases.title: Social creative tiles
showcases.text: Festive and product tiles that echo the hero of the site.

showcases.title: A Meta ad and a Google ad
showcases.text: Both reuse the festive hamper imagery from the homepage hero.
